effect.name: Glitch
effect.description: Torn horizontal bands, an RGB split and dropped lines. The corruption effect - good for damage, bad connections, and anything that should feel like the game itself is breaking.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: Overall severity. 0 is a clean image.

parameter.name: Time
parameter.description: Animate this or the glitch holds one frozen pattern.

parameter.name: Band Count
parameter.description: How many horizontal slices the image is torn into.

parameter.name: Tear Distance
parameter.description: How far a torn band slides sideways, in texels.

parameter.name: Colour Split
parameter.description: How far the red and blue channels come apart, in texels.

parameter.name: Dropped Lines
parameter.description: Chance a band goes black instead of tearing.
